instructions.lovable: Fetch /docs/manifest.json first. Read sections matching your task from 'lovable-integration' and 'edge-function'. Follow MUST/NEVER enforcement rules. Deploy the edge function to your Supabase project.
instructions.cursor: Fetch /docs/manifest.json first. Use section anchors to read only relevant parts of 'api-reference', 'integration-guide', and 'workflow-builder'. Project skills in .cursor/skills/ provide routing guidance.
